name: House Ghost
source:
Some bonds never fade - even after death.

You are Alex, a solitary man with no belief in the supernatural and seeking peace in a new home, old, forgotten house on the edge of town. The last thing he expects is company, especially from someone who no longer is alive. But behind the silence of dusty rooms and flickering lights, a quiet presence lingers.

A mysterious ghost, reserved yet oddly familiar, appears. He's bound by an untold story and a sorrow that clings like a mist. But as you uncover his past and spend time together, the connection deepens, turning curiosity into comfort and comfort into something more.

Will you help the ghost remember what he's lost and finally set him free?

Or will you choose to keep him near you?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1788160/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
有些纽带永远不会消失——即使在死后。

你是亚历克斯，一个孤独的人，不相信超自然现象，在城镇边缘的一所新家、一座被遗忘的老房子里寻求平静。他最不希望看到有人陪伴，尤其是来自一个已经不在人世的人。但在尘土飞扬的房间和闪烁的灯光的寂静背后，却存在着一种安静的存在。

一个神秘的幽灵出现了，他性格内向，但又奇怪地熟悉。他被一个不为人知的故事和如薄雾般笼罩的悲伤所束缚。但当你们揭开他的过去并共度时光时，你们之间的联系就会加深，将好奇变成安慰，又将安慰变成更多的东西。

你会帮助鬼魂记住他失去的东西并最终让他自由吗？

或者你会选择让他靠近你吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1788160/]Steam[/url]]
